label: caiso 44 startup bridge
definition: (PROBE) Startup-cost-aware CAISO RA must-offer bridge: also holds a committed CC/CT at min-load across a midday gap LONGER than min-down when cycling is uneconomic (startup_per_mw > (MC-LMP)*min_load_frac*gap_hours; MC/LMP forward-derivable, no measured pin). Also fixes the RA bridge, which was inert on the binned CAISO fleet (tranches carry min_down=0). Mechanism works — holds +590 MW more spring-midday gas (2024), displaces imports, and makes 2024 negative prices appear (LMP min +23.2->-20.0) with monthly LMP toward actuals. Not promoted: annual gas inflates slightly (+0.3-0.8 TWh) on an already-over baseline, so the mix-vs-EIA-923 + no-inflation gate is not cleared. Keeper caiso-42 stands.
